Discriminator.title: Alternative payment method data discriminator
Discriminator.description:
Type of alternative payment method (e.g. `Ideal`).

Ideal (iDEAL data.)

ApplePay (No additional data.)

GooglePay (No additional data.)

SepaDirectDebit (SEPA Direct Debit data.)

SepaDirectDebit.title: SEPA Direct Debit data
SepaDirectDebit.description: SEPA Direct Debit payment method data. Required when `Discriminator` is `SepaDirectDebit`.

Ideal.title: iDEAL data
Ideal.description: iDEAL payment method data. Required when `Discriminator` is `Ideal`.
